title.narrative: ICMPS CENTRO DE LA MUJER PERUANA FLORA TRISTAN V084 SANTIAGO

description.narrative: The Promoting the right to a life free of violence and access to justice for women, through legal advice, strategic litigation and communication project in Peru, implemented by Flora Tristán, aims to contribute to improving access to services and justice for women affected by gender-based violence in its various forms. The objectives of the grant are to improve women's access to justice by strengthening the legal advisory service of Flora Tristán, guaranteeing guidance to survivors of violence and/or relatives of victims. The key activities include providing guidance and care service for women victims of GBV, providing at least 250 consultations to women, promoting their access to justice and preventing re-victimization, provision of support in urgent cases, and dissemination of information materialpreparing and distrubuting informative brochures.
